The smooth compactified genus-one cubic T^3+W^3=2Z^3 has basepoint-free morphism gamma=Z^2/(TW) of degree 6. rho(t,z)=(omega*t,omega^2*z) and tau(t,z)=(1/t,z/t) form six distinct deck transformations and regular S3 Galois action. Ramification at gamma=0,1,omega,omega^2 has 3 simple index-2 points each and no infinity branch, satisfying Riemann-Hurwitz. Independent SymPy reconstruction verified polar, triple-contact Hessian, slope-sextic discriminant 2985984 gamma^9(gamma^3-1)^3. The finite check is algebraic corroboration, global geometry is proved in the source.
